purpose: Remove generated baked checkerboard without redrawing or distorting the logo.

method.alpha: Exterior stays 0; retained inner edge gets 3x3 local foreground-coverage alpha to reduce single-pixel jaggies; fully interior stays255.
method.visible_rgb: All retained RGB preserved bit-for-bit; only alpha differs at the one-pixel inner edge.
method.bright_white_protection: Near-neutral pixels with mean RGB >=225 are never included in exterior flood; preserves slipper white bands and gloss.

limits: Local raster background cleanup; not proof of original vector or exact pixel reconstruction.
qa_result: Reviewed composites on light blue and navy; visible art RGB preserved; no remaining baked checkerboard field. Bright slipper stripes protected after first QA.
